name: Abhishek Saikia
bio_long: A programmer based in India. I write here irregularly but with intention.

highlights: Developed a backend polling service in Go to monitor Hetzner Cloud infrastructure and detect server lifecycle events via REST API polling and state reconciliation, giving the infra team real-time visibility into server failures before they caused customer-facing downtime.

Built the ingestion layer feeding AWS cost/billing data into ClickHouse with tenant isolation and validation, enabling the platform to generate accurate multi-tenant cost reports without cross-customer data leakage.

Proposed and built a direct-ingestion API so customers could send billing data without granting an IAM role into their AWS S3 bucket — removing a security/access barrier that the standard AWS Data Exports path required for onboarding

Implemented transactional audit logging and an Outbox-based webhook delivery system with retries, ensuring idempotent event processing so downstream teams could trust alerts without duplicate or lost events

Deployed a centralized Kubernetes observability stack (Grafana Alloy, Loki, Grafana, ArgoCD) for cluster-wide log aggregation, cutting the time engineers spent tracing issues across services during incidents
